visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with black pigtails sits on a light-colored wooden floor. She wears a red t-shirt featuring a 'POTATO' graphic that serves as a physical pouch. She holds a long, thin, beige fries-shaped snack in her mouth, her gaze fixed forward with a neutral expression. The room is brightly lit by natural light filtered through a white paneled door behind her. (2) The perspective shifts as the girl is now seated on the lap of an adult wearing a black top. The girl reaches her small hand into the t-shirt pouch, pulling out another snack stick. Her facial expression is focused as she manipulates the snack. (3) The girl extends her hand, offering a piece of the snack towards the person off-camera. She looks up with large, curious eyes and a slight pout while chewing. The background shows a portion of the living room with soft indoor lighting. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the girl's face as she eats and reacts to the conversation, her pigtails slightly bobbing. She holds several snacks in her hands. (5) The final scene transitions to a solid pink background featuring a small, cartoon illustration of the girl in the center, accompanied by fixed white text at the bottom.
